correctness.rationale: Uniform root splitting with independent Yule daughters yields the stated conditional additive recurrences. The cherry boundary mean correction is supported only at subtree sizes 1 and 2. Total covariance gives K_n=2/(n-1) sum K_k+2(2H_{n-2}-3n+7)/(3(n-1)); an explicit induction cancels harmonic terms and proves -(n-3)(5n-8)/(9(n-1)) for all n>=3. Boundary n=2,3 and strict sign for n>=4 follow. Direct exact probabilities/independent LCA evaluation and a second mixed-moment recurrence pass 4746 assertions through specified finite sizes, but are not treated as exhaustive infinite proof. Asymptotic correlation uses external proven marginal variances.

value.rationale: The number of cherries and total cophenetic index are established, complementary indices of local recent branching and shared-ancestry depth. Their exact covariance is strictly negative from n=4, has a nontrivial boundary-supported cancellation mechanism, and reveals n^(-3/2) normalized decorrelation; this is pertinent to joint null behavior of tree-shape diagnostics and not a mere restatement of separate marginal formulas.
